$comment: When a request may be repeated. Failure kinds are produced by api/http-error-mapping.json and api/transport-error-mapping.json. The SDK has no automatic retry loop for any request; 'safeToRepeat' tells callers (the poller, the UI retry button) whether a repetition is allowed at all.

kinds.meaning: The request provably never reached the server.
The server answered with a definitive refusal; nothing changed.
kinds.note: Repeating only makes sense after the cause is fixed (new session, new code, waiting after 429).

kinds.meaning: A mutating request may have taken effect.

endpoints.automaticRetry: none (one repeat after a session refresh on 401)
by the poller within its budget

endpoints.userRetry: only after not_delivered or rejected (same transaction), or a new code after a rejected code

rules: A transport error is not proof that the request was not sent; only failures that prove no connection was made are not_delivered.
A 2xx answer to POST /transactions without a valid transaction id is outcome_unknown.
A 2xx answer with a valid id but no usable redirectUrl keeps the transaction; its status is polled.
Cancelling the caller never abandons a POST already handed to the transport; its outcome is still settled.
No idempotency key is sent: the SimPay API does not document one. Until it does, outcome_unknown on creation cannot be resolved by the app.
